kaikki_vikisozluk.t: For the first sense (and possibly the third), the plural of كُرْبَاج (kurbāj, “whip”). For the second sense: Borrowed from Ottoman Turkish كرپیچ (kerpiç, “unbaked brick”), comparing the raw state of bricks to this pastry.
s: Borrowed from Ottoman Turkish كرپیچ (kerpiç, “unbaked brick”)
g: Hard, plum-sized cookies, normally made with semolina and nuts
Pastries consisting of fried strips of dough that are soaked in syrup, usually crispy on the outside and soft and wet on the inside
